type: ∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v), Rocq.Corelib.Program.Basics.arrow A B = (A → B)
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.basics_arrow_agrees

type: ∀ (P Q : Prop), Rocq.Corelib.Program.Basics.impl P Q ↔ P → Q
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.basics_impl_agrees

type: ∀ {A : Sort u} {B : Sort v} {C : Sort w} (f : A → B → C), Rocq.Corelib.Program.Basics.flip A B C f = fun b a => f a b
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.basics_flip_agrees

type: ∀ {A : Sort u} {B : Sort v} (a : A), Rocq.Corelib.Program.Basics.const A B a = fun x => a
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.basics_const_agrees

type: ∀ {A : Sort u} {B : Sort v} (f : A → B) (x : A), Rocq.Corelib.Program.Basics.apply A B f x = f x
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.basics_apply_agrees

type: ∀ {A : Sort u} {B : Sort v} {C : Sort w} (g : B → C) (f : A → B), Rocq.Corelib.Program.Basics.compose A B C g f = g ∘ f
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.basics_compose_agrees
